name: Columns
summary: Side-by-side columns that collapse to a stack on compact layouts: a main column with a narrower one beside it, or equal halves.

children.description: One component per column, in reading order

layout.description: 'two-thirds' is a wide first column (GOV.UK's default); 'one-third' the reverse; 'halves' and 'thirds' equal; 'sidebar-*' a fixed 18rem column at that edge

collapse.description: The width below which the columns stack

whenToUse: A form with help beside it; a record with a summary beside it; a list beside a preview
Anywhere a wide screen should use its width without the compact screen paying for it
whenNotToUse: Metrics in a row: use Group with arrangement 'inline'
A master–detail pair that keeps both alive: use Split

requirements: Reading order is the children's order at every width

agent: Invisible: reads the children in order.
rendering: Gutter space.inline.loose between columns; stacked with space.stack.loose
Column widths follow the layout; 'sidebar-*' columns never shrink below 16rem
Collapses at the surface's width, not the viewport's

mappings.web: GOV.UK grid row, Polaris Layout, Carbon Grid, Bootstrap row/col
